description: This file contains React hooks for user data management, including fetching user data from an API and aggregating users by department. It defines functions useUsers and aggregateUsersByDepartment, both exported for use in other components or modules.

methods.name: useUsers({ page, limit, sort, filter } = {})
methods.description: A React hook to fetch users from the backend API with support for pagination, sorting, and filtering. It manages loading, error, and data state, and provides a refetch method.

methods.name: aggregateUsersByDepartment(users)
methods.description: A utility function to group an array of user objects by their department, counting the number of users per department, excluding invalid or unknown departments.
